US Lawmaker Ro Khanna Reports Detention by Israeli Settlers in West Bank

US Representative Ro Khanna stated he and his delegation were detained by armed Israeli settlers while visiting the West Bank. The incident occurred near a Palestinian village reportedly abandoned due to settler attacks. Khanna claimed Israeli security forces sided with the settlers and did not assist his group. The event has drawn attention to settler violence and the status of Israeli settlements.
